title: Brush descriptor (brush/v1) — the serializable projection of a registry entry
description: E-32 T-128-01: the brush contract's schema half. Functions (generate/fn/apply/merge/preview.realize) exist only on the live entry; the semantic layer in src/pack/brush-contract.mjs checks them. This schema validates everything else: identity, kind, composition (the chaining declaration), style-level paramsSchema, preview declaration, and the test pointer.

kind.description: construct: uniformly callable spec → {cells}. pass: build-transform with its natural signature over an occupancy + context.

source.description: Repo-relative path of the module where the technique lives.

tests.description: Repo-relative path of the unit-test file that proves the technique (the contract's test requirement).

composition.description: What the brush consumes and emits, so brushes chain — closed vocabularies.

paramsSchema.description: JSON-schema fragment over STYLE-level parameters (partial — must accept {}; the semantic layer compiles it).

preview.description: The preview-card requirement: a construct points at committed card specs; a pass declares a synthetic subject (substrate + params) its in-entry realize() acts on.
